# Flask-ADB-toolkit

> Menu-driven adb & fastboot toolkit for any Android device — auto ROM flashing, generic partition tools, checksum verification, and maintenance helpers, all in one friendly terminal menu.

Flask-ADB-toolkit is a single Bash script (`flask-adb-toolkit.sh`) with a Windows launcher (`flask-adb-toolkit.bat` + `flask-adb-toolkit.ps1`). It wraps the real `adb` and `fastboot` binaries in a numbered menu, auto-detects device state (booted, recovery, fastboot, sideload), and asks for `YES` confirmation before any destructive operation. It works on Linux, macOS, and Windows, and targets every Android device that speaks standard ADB/Fastboot — it is not tied to a specific OEM or ROM.

The script never auto-flashes `system.img`; that partition is normally logical and is installed by the ROM's own installer zip. ROM flashing covers `vbmeta`, `vbmeta_system`, `dtbo`, `boot`, `init_boot`, `vendor_boot`, `super_empty`, and the ROM zip itself, in a safe order, followed by a reboot-to-recovery and sideload. Generic partition flashing accepts any partition name with optional slot suffix and vbmeta verification flags.

## Site & Source

- [Live site](https://dedsec-1337.github.io/Flask-ADB-toolkit/): Project homepage with feature overview, quick start, and uninstall instructions. Deployed from the `docs/` folder via GitHub Actions.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/dedsec-1337/Flask-ADB-toolkit): Canonical source, issue tracker, and release notes.
- [README](https://github.com/dedsec-1337/Flask-ADB-toolkit#readme): Full feature list, menu reference, and per-OS installation notes.

## Installable Artifacts

- [`flask-adb-toolkit.sh`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dedsec-1337/Flask-ADB-toolkit/main/flask-adb-toolkit.sh): Main Bash script for Linux, macOS, and WSL. Make executable with `chmod +x` and run.
- [`flask-adb-toolkit.bat`](https://github.com/dedsec-1337/Flask-ADB-toolkit/blob/main/flask-adb-toolkit.bat) + [`flask-adb-toolkit.ps1`](https://github.com/dedsec-1337/Flask-ADB-toolkit/blob/main/flask-adb-toolkit.ps1): Windows launcher. Double-click the `.bat`; it runs the PowerShell script which finds Git Bash, offers platform-tools if missing, then hands off to the `.sh`.

## Feature Reference

- Auto-detecting ROM flash: Scans a ROM folder for known partition images and the ROM zip, flashes in a safe order, then reboots to recovery and sideloads.
- Generic partition flash: Flash `boot`, `init_boot`, `recovery`, `vbmeta`, `system`, `super`, or any custom partition name, with slot suffix handling and vbmeta verification flags.
- Checksum verifier: Computes SHA256 of a file and compares it to an expected value before flashing.
- Recovery & sideload helpers: Reboot to recovery from fastboot or booted mode, standalone sideloading for GApps/Magisk zips, reboot-to-system from recovery.
- Maintenance & cleanup: Resumable performance pass (speed-compiles every app), deep-clean for orphaned app data, battery and storage reports, live logcat, screenshots, APK installs.
- Device info & file transfer: Live device status bar (connection mode, bootloader lock state, active slot), dump all fastboot variables, pull and push files.
- CMF Phone 2 Pro stock restore: Dedicated restore options for the CMF Phone 2 Pro (Galaga) — newest (B4.1) and older (V3.2) builds, both slots.

## Requirements

- `adb` and `fastboot` on PATH (or bundled `platform-tools` for the Windows `.bat`).
- Linux: `android-tools-adb` and `android-tools-fastboot` via the distro package manager, or Homebrew's `android-platform-tools` on macOS.
- Bash 4+ for the `.sh` version. Git Bash or WSL on Windows for the full colour menu.

## Uninstall

- Remove the script: `rm -f ~/flask-adb-toolkit.sh ~/.flask-adb-compile-progress`
- Windows: delete `flask-adb-toolkit.bat` and, optionally, the `platform-tools` folder.
